author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Legendary studio BioWare is being shut down, as mass layoffs hit owner Electronic Arts. Around fifty employees at BioWare are being let go, with the rest presumably moved to different teams. As a result, the next Mass Effect game that was teased years ago has been canceled. And in other news, a new report from Bloomberg suggests the new Xbox Project Helix console could cost as much as $1,800 if Microsoft decides to not subsidize or eat the cost of some of the components. The console could launch in 2028, with a new handheld to precede it in 2027.

#MassEffect #BioWare #Gaming
title: Next Mass Effect Canceled as EA Shuts Down BioWare - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Nintendo Switch Sports Resort reviewed by Jesse Vitelli on Nintendo Switch 2.

"Nintendo Switch Sports Resort shines as the party game it’s meant to be, perfect to bring to your friend’s place or get the backyard barbeque bumping. Its single-player options widen the package with a light campaign and an amusing free exploration mode, but it’s not a big surprise that neither do quite enough to take the spotlight away from the highs of its multiplayer. And while there are a few weak games like Basketball and Power Cruising, more exciting sports like Archery, Skateboarding, and even Thumb Wrestling make this a fun and playful collection overall."
title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Review

description:
Get a deep dive into the features of Crimson Desert's upcoming Charting the Unknown DLC in this new trailer for the open-world action-adventure RPG. The new trailer showcases what awaits in the Charting the Unknown DLC, including new stories, ocean voyages, underwater exploration, ship building, establishing strongholds, deeper relationships with certain characters across Pywel, business management and expanded housing. 

In Charting the Unknown, the stories of the main characters, Kliff, Damiane and Oongka, continue as each sets out to forge their own path. Along the way, they will encounter allies and threats, both old and new, as they chart their own course forward.

Crimson Desert Enhanced: Charting the Unknown will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and Epic Games Store on October 29, 2026 at 22:00 UTC | 23:00 CEST.
